name: ailogracer
description: Problem-solving platform that scores the solution and how well participants used AI to reach it.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: docker-compose up -d db && npm --prefix server run sandbox:build && npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix server run test:api && npm --prefix client run typecheck
